answers.core:
In most cases this is really unintuitive.
And it makes using things like the CanvasGroup really inconvenient, which are great for making UI animations.
answers.workaround:
Can be worked around with a dummy control node between Node2D and the control node, and sync the position and size of the dummy with another control node up the tree using a script.
But this is quite hacky (it's hard to get it work with scales for example) and makes the node path very long and complicated.
